suites.name: independent keyboard, no-JS and asset acceptance

nojs_accessibility_method: Keyboard, navigation, images and downloads are exercised with browser JavaScript disabled. For axe only, a separate diagnostic context suppresses the site script and must match the real no-JS DOM exactly before scanning; the real no-JS page is never enabled.

screenshot_evidence.note: Browser evidence and test tooling are deliberately outside the deployable website.

limits: Direct download URL format and architecture mapping were verified; public release availability is a separate release-owner check.
Local browser verification is not a claim that GitHub Pages has been deployed.
App screenshots use a local demonstration service and do not benchmark online model performance.
Automated accessibility scanning does not replace assistive-technology and human testing.
Linux is not hardware-tested; Windows v0.1.5 interactions still require a hardware retest.
